title: checkin_resource: PUT /config/checkin, POST /checkin, POST /rollcall missing OSCORE/local-admin gate
description: Root cause: checkin_resource.c was written against lichen_coap_respond only and skipped the coap_oscore_unprotect_resource_request + is_protected/lichen_coap_is_local_admin gate every sibling resource uses (coap_server.c:191, coap_msg.c:1946, coap_config.c:752, coap_location.c:1298). (P0) PUT /config/checkin (checkin_resource.c:224-254): any mesh node can rewrite scheduled check-in config - set target to attacker addr with include_location=true (periodic location exfiltration per 18.6.4), disable safety check-ins, or set interval_s=1 (radio flood). Fix: unprotect with COAP_METHOD_PUT, add is_protected||local_admin gate, respond via coap_oscore_respond_resource, read oscore.payload. (P1) POST /rollcall (145-174): unauthenticated 4-packet 7-day table squat (capacity default 4, timeout up to 604800) and id-reset wipes responded/missing lists - require OSCORE and/or restrict id-reset to creating identity. (P2) POST /checkin (90-117): forged/overwritten presence - any peer can overwrite a genuine help check-in keyed on self-asserted node text; gate POST and verify node matches authenticated source IID; make documented decision on unauthenticated GET /checkin exposure.
close_reason: Fixed all three endpoints in checkin_resource.c: unprotect via coap_oscore_unprotect_resource_request (POST/POST/PUT), gate is_protected||lichen_coap_is_local_admin -> 4.01, respond via coap_oscore_respond_resource, read oscore.payload (house pattern per coap_config.c config_put / coap_msg.c msg_ack). (b) rollcall: gate added; id-reset — creator identity is NOT recorded in the oracle-matched service layer (struct lichen_rollcall has no creator field), so identity-conditioned reset is not derivable here; restricted re-POST of a known id to capacity semantics by restoring responded/missing counts after lichen_rollcall_post wipes them (started/timeout_s still update). Local-admin fallback kept per house convention (all cited siblings use is_protected||local_admin); strict OSCORE-only for rollcall would need a decision if wanted. (c) checkin: gated; authenticated source identity IS available post-unprotect (ctx lookup keys on the source-address IID, so AEAD success binds the source address) -> node-vs-source enforced, 4.03 on mismatch. Residual risk: the local-admin path may post on behalf of any node (trusted on-device client, by design). GET exposure left as-is (public read); decision filed as follow-up. Verification: twister lichen.checkin_resource on qemu_x86_64 8/8 test cases passed incl. new regressions (unauthenticated_writes_rejected, oscore_checkin_node_binding, rollcall_repost_preserves_lists); host suite lichen/tests/checkin_rollcall 1/1 green; cppcheck clean. Note: native_sim/qemu_x86(32) cannot run locally (twister 4.1 filters native platforms on macOS; no i686 SDK toolchain; ZEPHYR_EXTRA_MODULES triggers the known zcbor Kconfig loop) — ran the suite without the module flag, which this suite does not need.
